original.target_description: Study 3: restaurant Studio 97 versus Studio 17; Cornell undergraduates; main effect of number in the 2 × 3 ANOVA of log-transformed willingness to pay. Locator p. 7 corresponds to printed p. 247. No subgroup is specified, so the main effect is selected.

n.exclusions: No exclusions reported for this study; the six-cell ANOVA residual df is 188.
n.quote: One hundred ninety-four Cornell University undergraduates completed the study

es.quote: The main effect of number was significant, F(1, 188) ¼ 4.91, p ¼ .03

replication.target_description: Study 3: Restaurant item, Studio 97 versus Studio 17, independent-samples comparison of willingness-to-pay estimates after outlier exclusions.

n.location: p.8, Table 3, Restaurant row, High n and Low n columns
n.sample_role: Participants contributing one restaurant estimate each to the independent two-group test; sum of mutually exclusive final High and Low anchor groups.
n.exclusions: Preregistered item-specific 1.5 IQR outlier exclusion rule; p.7 reports 4.62% across observations and no missing values. Primary Table 3 excludes outliers; exploratory all-data analysis on p.8 is separate. Recruitment N=874 is not used as analytic N.

p.location: p. 8, Table 3 Restaurant row; p. 7 Results; no numerical p printed for this test (table reports t, df and BF).

reported_success.quote: There was no significant anchoring effect for the ... Restaurant (Studio 97 vs. Studio 17) question with almost ... identical mean estimates in the high and low anchor ... groups

notes:
Matching uses only supplied study/outcome/locator. Indistinguishable repeated locators are extracted identically; no item or subgroup is inferred from audit ID or input order. Printed group ns retained separately, without computing a total. 
Completion source review (n_r): Final Restaurant High and Low n are explicitly printed and belong to mutually exclusive groups in this independent-samples test. Preregistered item-specific 1.5 IQR outlier exclusion rule; p.7 reports 4.62% across observations and no missing values. Primary Table 3 excludes outliers; exploratory all-data analysis on p.8 is separate. Recruitment N=874 is not used as analytic N.
Completion source review (reported_success): Authors explicitly describe failure to find the restaurant anchoring effect; failed is the narrative replication verdict, not an inference from a computed p.
